constraints: @types/dotenv only declares types; dotenv now ships its own declarations, so no conflicting ambient definition may remain.

steps.instructions: Remove @types/dotenv from devDependencies and any explicit reference to it, such as a tsconfig.json compilerOptions.types entry.
steps.title: Remove the stub types package

steps.instructions: Keep dotenv on a version that ships its own type definitions and import its types from dotenv.
steps.title: Use the bundled declarations

verification.purpose: Type-check and build with dotenv's own declarations.
Run the repository tests when defined.

rule.summary: npm marks @types/dotenv as deprecated: "This is a stub types definition. dotenv provides its own type definitions, so you do not need this installed."
rule.title: @types/dotenv is deprecated
